notes: Validated 2026-07-27 vs 17,567 ICD9CM concept_codes: 0 FN on real codes. The 3 non-matches are vocabulary defects, not codes: 92 (deleted, leading zero stripped from 092), sd (corrupt), XX0.00 (Not Applicable, OI-minted concept_id 100000089). Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 164 of 21,248 tabular tokens and 1,040 of 17,570 paper tokens match, ZERO of them an ordinary word - every hit is a bare number. NOT NARROWED and not narrowable: \d{3} IS a real code form (250, 042), so every 3-digit number in running text validates. Usable for detection only with context.

Medicare claims data often reports these without the dot. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN (same 3 defect rows as ICD9CM). Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 142 tabular / 1,836 paper tokens, all bare numbers - \d{3,5} is the real dotless form. Not narrowable, and weaker than ICD9CM in text: a 4-digit token in a paper is far more often a year than a code.

ICD-9-CM Volume 3 procedures. NOTE the OHDSI vocabulary_id is ICD9Proc, NOT ICD9CM - procedures are a separate vocabulary from diagnoses. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 4,657 concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 118 tabular / 989 paper tokens, 0 ordinary words. Not narrowable - '12' and '15.99' are genuinely the code shape, so this row cannot separate a procedure code from a number in prose.

Papers and claims extracts print these without the dot (6662 = 66.62). Directly evidenced by litmine pilot 2026-07. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 109 tabular / 1,793 paper tokens, every one a bare 2-4 digit number, years included. Deliberate and not narrowable; detection needs context.

Dot is OPTIONAL. Three-character category codes (I10, E11, F10, N18) are real codes and are stored dotless. Requiring the dot rejected 1,953 real codes (regression, 2026-07-25). Validated 2026-07-27 vs 100,035 concept_codes: 0 FN. Position 1 is a LETTER: narrowed 2026-08-12 from ^\w{3}(\.\w{1,4})?$, which accepted 16,100 of 17,564 ICD9CM concept_codes (250.00, V45.81, 042) plus bare digits and _-leading junk. Validated vs 100,035 ICD10CM concept_codes in Athena 20260625: 0 FN. Positions 2-3 stay \w deliberately - FY2026 introduced QA0, a LETTER in position 2, and the permissive tail is why this row needed no edit for it. Position 2 narrowed 2026-08-12 from \w to (digit | the literal QA): measured over the FY2026 tabular corpus, \w there admitted 426 additional ordinary word-tokens (ABC, ALL, ARE, Age, Air, AST, AML) while removing ZERO cross-vocabulary false positives - ICD9CM acceptance is 1,357 either way, because V## and E### are already letter+digit. QA is enumerated because FY2026's QA0 is the only ICD-10-CM category ever to carry a letter in position 2 (FY2025: zero). ONE false negative, excluded deliberately: NOD.X ('No diagnosis', concept_id 35209512) is invalid_reason='D', retired 2009-12-31. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir) against a SECOND corpus, 20 PubMed Central papers: 119 of 17,570 tokens, none of them an ordinary word - the 2026-08-12 narrowing holds on literature prose as well as on the tabular.

Medicare claims data often reports these without the dot. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN. Position 1 is a LETTER: narrowed 2026-08-12 from ^\w{3,7}$, which accepted 17,562 of 17,564 ICD9CM concept_codes - nearly the entire vocabulary. Validated vs 100,035 ICD10CM concept_codes dotted-stripped in Athena 20260625: 0 FN. Position 2 narrowed 2026-08-12 to (digit | the literal QA), matching the ICD10CM row. Validated vs 100,035 ICD10CM concept_codes dot-stripped: 1 FN, the retired NOD.X (invalid_reason='D'), excluded deliberately. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir) against the 20-paper corpus: 212 of 17,570 tokens, 0 ordinary words.

WHO ICD-10, distinct from ICD10CM. Three branches: codes (A20, A30.8, M23.07), SubChapter ranges (A15-A19), and Chapter roman numerals (I..XXII). Validated 2026-07-27 vs 16,638 concept_codes: 0 FN on real codes; excludes 351 placeholder rows named Invalid ICD10 Concept, do not use whose concept_code is just the concept_id (e.g. 45532996). NARROWED 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir), mirroring the ICD10CM edit of 2026-08-12 but measured on its own: position 1 to a letter and position 2 to a digit, in the code branch and in both halves of the range branch. Evidence - all 16,265 non-chapter in-target codes are letter+2 digits (13,898 ICD10 code + 2,093 ICD10 Hierarchy, shape Add) and all 274 SubChapter ranges are Add-Add. Position 3 stays [0-9A-Za-z] DELIBERATELY: ICD-10-CM's C4A proves a letter in position 3 is a real ICD-10-family shape. The chapter branch was [IVXLCDM]{1,5}, which also accepted MIX, CIVIL, DIM and LIVID; it is now the 22 WHO chapters enumerated - concepts 40474979-40475000, class ICD10 Chapter, a closed set (ICD-10 is frozen, ICD-11 is the successor) that just test re-checks against every release. Measured: 6,390 of 21,248 tabular tokens -> 5,922 (439 ordinary words -> 15) and 1,899 of 17,570 paper tokens -> 127 (674 -> 8). 0 FN over all 16,287 in-target codes. The dot tail stays \w{1,4} although every published tail is \d{1,2}: narrowing it removes a further 473 tabular tokens but NOT ONE ordinary word (they are all code-shaped ICD-10-CM extensions), so permissiveness breaks that tie.

Dotless form of ICD10. Upper bound 7 mirrors ICD10CM.DOTLESS for headroom; WHO ICD-10 only reaches 5 dotless today. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN on real codes (same 351 placeholder exclusions). NARROWED 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir) in step with ICD10, and this is where it mattered most: \w{3,7} accepted most of the dictionary. Measured 7,022 of 21,248 tabular tokens -> 1,368 (5,565 ordinary words -> 15) and 7,967 of 17,570 paper tokens -> 220 (5,752 -> 8), at 0 FN over all 16,287 in-target codes. Chapter branch enumerated to the 22 WHO chapters; see the ICD10 note for the evidence.

Full codes are 7 characters; 1-6 character codes are real hierarchy/partial-code concepts. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 197,098 concept_codes: 0 FN on real codes; excludes MTHU000001-3 (UMLS GEM mapping-table nodes). NARROWED 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir) to the PCS alphabet: the ICD-10-PCS spec excludes the letters I and O from every axis so they cannot be confused with 1 and 0, and the published vocabulary confirms it exactly - the charset over all 197,095 in-target codes is 0123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ, zero I and zero O. 0 FN. Measured 7,308 of 21,248 tabular tokens -> 3,793 (5,708 ordinary words -> 2,323) and 8,686 of 17,570 paper tokens -> 5,240 (6,274 -> 2,859). This REVERSES the earlier 'deliberately not tightened, usage-specific strictness belongs in the caller' note, which judged the same edit only as a way to tell PCS from ICD-10-CM - a cross-vocabulary question. Against prose it is the row's own alphabet and it is free. Still the LOOSEST row in the table: 2,323 ordinary words survive (any i/o-free word of 1-7 characters), so it cannot carry its own weight in a text scan. Case stays permissive on purpose - every published code is uppercase and [0-9A-HJ-NP-Z]{1,7} would cut the tabular figure to 1,695, but a caller that lowercases before validating would then get a silent 100% false-negative rate.

Billable HCPCS Level II codes. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 12,822 concept_codes: 0 FN on class HCPCS; excludes 385 HCPCS Modifier (see .WITHMODIFIERS), 106 HCPCS Class BETOS groupers (D1A, I1A, T1A), 151 Clinical Finding lookup values (RH, @@, @Q, bare letters) and HCPC (a deprecated LONG DESCRIPTION marker). Position 1 narrowed 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir) from \w to a letter: all 12,178 class-HCPCS codes are letter+4 digits, the sole exception being the already-excluded HCPC marker. 0 FN. Prose: 0 tabular hits either way, 164 -> 27 paper tokens, no ordinary words in either direction.

OMOP stores modifiers using the same vocabulary_id as HCPCS :-( Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN over classes HCPCS + HCPCS Modifier. Narrowed 2026-08-13 in step with HCPCS, but the \w{2} branch dominates what this row admits: 244 tabular / 720 paper tokens, of which 111 and 506 are ordinary two-letter English words (of, in, to, at, is, be). NOT USABLE FOR DETECTION IN FREE TEXT - use it where the input is already known to be a code, or scan with the bare HCPCS row and handle modifiers from context.

Validated 2026-07-27 vs the 385 HCPCS Modifier concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 244 tabular / 693 paper tokens, 111 and 506 of them ordinary two-letter English words. NOT NARROWED - that number is the honest shape, not a defect: a HCPCS modifier IS two alphanumerics, so THIS ROW CANNOT CARRY ITS OWN WEIGHT IN A PROSE SCAN and must be used with context (a modifier field, or the code it modifies). The one available narrowing was measured and declined: all 385 published modifiers are letter-first (289 AA + 96 Ad), so [A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z] would drop 85 tabular / 152 paper tokens - but it leaves every two-letter word untouched, and CMS defines the modifier as two alphanumeric characters, so a digit-leading one is not structurally impossible.

WIDENED 2026-07-27 from ^\d{4}\w$, which rejected the real code M0201 (in-home COVID-19 vaccine administration). Every CPT4 code is 5 characters with digits in positions 2-4; the first character may be a letter. 0 FN over class CPT4; excludes 3,787 CPT4 Hierarchy groupers, 544 CPT4 Modifier (see .WITHMODIFIERS), 50 Visit, 7 Global period metadata and 9 UMLS source markers (V-CPT, V-SRC, V-HCPT, ...). Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 1 tabular / 168 paper tokens, ZERO ordinary words - every hit is a 5-digit number, which is exactly what a CPT code is. Already as narrow as the shape allows.

OMOP stores modifiers using the same vocabulary_id as CPT4 :-( Widened in step with CPT4. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN over classes CPT4 + CPT4 Modifier. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 245 tabular / 861 paper tokens, 111 and 506 of them ordinary two-letter words, all via the \w{2} modifier branch. Same caveat as HCPCS.WITHMODIFIERS - not usable for detection in free text.

Validated 2026-07-27 vs the 544 CPT4 Modifier concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 244 tabular / 693 paper tokens, 111 and 506 ordinary two-letter words. NOT NARROWED and, unlike HCPCS_MODIFIER, not even narrowable to letter-first: the 544 CPT4 modifiers include digit-leading (124) and all-digit (40) forms, so \w{2} is the true shape. The row cannot carry its own weight in a prose scan; use it with context.

OI hybrid procedure vocabulary (csc-171): CPT4 + HCPCS unioned and deduped, 30,357 concepts, because the digit/letter split is administrative not clinical. DELIBERATELY permissive about which SIDE a code comes from - it admits both digit-leading (CPT) and letter-leading (HCPCS) codes, which is the entire point. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN on billable codes; excludes V-CPT and V-SRC (UMLS source markers), 3,787 CPT4 Hierarchy, 549 modifiers (see .WITHMODIFIERS), 106 HCPCS Class, 50 Visit. NARROWED 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir) from \w{5}, which matched every 5-letter English word: both parents already require digits in positions 2-4 (CPT4 is \w\d{3}\w, HCPCS is [A-Za-z]\d{4}, a subset of it), so \w\d{3}\w costs 0 FN over all 25,848 in-target codes and keeps position 1 open, preserving the permissiveness this row exists for. Measured 1,174 of 21,248 tabular tokens -> 1 (1,158 ordinary words -> 0) and 1,364 of 17,570 paper tokens -> 168 (1,182 -> 0). The row is now spelled identically to CPT4, which is correct and not redundant: every HCPCS code (letter + 4 digits) already fits the CPT4 shape, so the shape of the union IS the CPT4 shape. The rows stay separate because they name different targets and different lookup vocabularies - a code binds against CPT4_HCPCS in the OI build, not against CPT4.

CPT4_HCPCS plus 2-character modifiers, mirroring the CPT4/HCPCS rows. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN over billable codes + all 549 modifier concepts. Narrowed 2026-08-13 in step with CPT4_HCPCS: 1,418 tabular tokens -> 245 and 2,057 paper tokens -> 861, 0 FN. What remains is the \w{2} branch - 111 tabular / 506 paper ordinary two-letter words - so like the other .WITHMODIFIERS rows this one is not usable for detection in free text.

Validated 2026-07-27 vs the 549 modifier concept_codes in CPT4_HCPCS (385 HCPCS Modifier + 164 CPT4 Modifier): 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 244 tabular / 693 paper tokens, 111 and 506 ordinary two-letter words. NOT NARROWED: the union carries CPT4's digit-leading and all-digit modifiers, so \w{2} is the true shape here even though the 385 HCPCS-side modifiers are all letter-first. The row cannot carry its own weight in a prose scan.

CLAIMS DEFAULT (vfm-k2n): the 11-digit billing form, labeler-product-package — what appears on a claim. NDC.COMPLETE carries the full vocabulary. NB ^\d{11}$ alone rejects 338,303 real 9-digit concept_codes, which is CORRECT for this row's target and a bug for NDC.COMPLETE's. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN vs the 964,647 eleven-digit concept_codes (25 of which are alphanumeric - use NDC.ALPHANUM). Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): ZERO hits in both corpora - no 11-digit token occurs in either. Together with RxNorm Extension the tightest row in the table.

The FULL vocabulary, not just the claims form: 9-digit is FDA labeler+product without the package segment (337,085 class '9-digit NDC' + 1,218 Device). Validated 2026-07-27 vs all 1,302,950 concept_codes: 0 FN on all-numeric codes; the 39 alphanumeric ones need NDC.ALPHANUM. See vfm-8l5. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 0 tabular / 7 paper tokens, all bare 9- or 11-digit numbers.

Why alphanumeric: https://forums.ohdsi.org/t/ndc-codes-with-letters/1142/2 - widened alongside NDC to admit the 9-digit form. Validated 2026-07-27 vs all 1,302,950 NDC concept_codes: 0 FN. NARROWED 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir) from (\w{9}|\w{11}), which matched every 9- and 11-letter English word: every one of the 1,302,950 published codes begins with 5 digits (the FDA labeler segment - true of all 39 alphanumeric ones too, e.g. 00019N068, 041163NEW, 531570AS3BO), so (\d{5}\w{4}|\d{5}\w{6}) costs 0 FN and survives a future 6-digit labeler. Measured 2,899 of 21,248 tabular tokens -> 0 (all 2,899 were ordinary words) and 1,940 of 17,570 paper tokens -> 7 (1,892 -> 0).

RXCUI. Observed 2-7 digits; upper bound 8 is headroom. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 315,157 concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 109 tabular / 2,676 paper tokens, all bare numbers. NOT NARROWABLE - an RXCUI IS a bare 2-8 digit number, which makes it the loosest numeric row for literature scanning: 2,676 of the 17,570 distinct tokens in the 20-paper corpus - 15% of everything printed - validate. Use it with context.

OMOP-minted extension for drugs absent from RxNorm; codes are literally OMOP followed by digits. Note the vocabulary_id contains a SPACE. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 2,171,452 concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): ZERO hits in both corpora - the literal OMOP prefix makes this the tightest row in the table.

WHO ATC. Matches all five levels: A / A01 / A01A / A01AA / A01AB02. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 7,327 concept_codes: 0 FN. Not to be confused with the separate EphMRA ATC vocabulary. LEVEL 1 ENUMERATED 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): the 14 anatomical main groups (A B C D G H J L M N P R S V) are the complete ATC 1st level - 14 concepts, class ATC 1st - and all 7,327 codes at every level start with one of them, so [A-Za-z] was strictly wider than the vocabulary itself. 0 FN. Measured 1,384 of 21,248 tabular tokens -> 744 and 117 of 17,570 paper tokens -> 68; the single-letter branch went from 47 to 27 ordinary-word hits (before this, EVERY letter of the alphabet validated as an ATC code). Most of the rest of the gain is cross-vocabulary: E11, K21 and other ICD-10 categories fit [A-Za-z]\d{2} and no longer fit here. Enumerated rather than generalised because the set is closed - WHO has not added a main group since ATC's inception - and just test re-checks it against every release.

NUMERIC ONLY (vfm-27p): every one of the 464,018 UUID-shaped SNOMED concept_codes is INVALID (invalid_reason U=367,198 / D=96,820; zero valid), so a numeric-only default rejects nothing valid. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN vs all VALID SNOMED concept_codes. Retired concepts need SNOMED.WITHRETIRED. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 0 tabular / 772 paper tokens, all bare 6-18 digit numbers, which is what a SNOMED id is. Not narrowable.

Includes the UUID form used by RETIRED/withdrawn SNOMED concepts (464,018 rows, all invalid). Named for what distinguishes them - retirement - NOT the UK drug extension: the largest class is Physical Object (194,791), not drugs. Caveat: this accepts ANY UUID as a SNOMED code. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN vs all 1,093,147 concept_codes. See vfm-27p. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 0 tabular / 772 paper tokens - identical to SNOMED, because no UUID-shaped token occurs in either corpus. The 'accepts ANY UUID' caveat above is a cross-vocabulary risk, not a prose one.

CMS Diagnosis-Related Group, always 3 zero-padded digits. 1,362 rows but only 871 distinct concept_codes - the same code recurs across DRG versions, so a lookup on (code, vocabulary_id) is NOT unique here. Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 27 tabular / 951 paper tokens, every one a bare 3-digit number. NOT NARROWED and not narrowable - a DRG IS three digits, so THIS ROW CANNOT CARRY ITS OWN WEIGHT IN A PROSE SCAN. Run it against a DRG field, not against running text.

Papers and claims extracts frequently drop the leading zeros (DRG 1 for 001), the same trap as .DOTLESS. Validated 2026-07-27 vs all 1,362 DRG concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 102 tabular / 1,061 paper tokens, i.e. every 1-3 digit number in the text. Weaker still than DRG for detection, deliberately so, because papers drop the padding.

Stock OHDSI ICD-O-3 (SEER Site/Histology). Codes are COMPOSITE histology-topography pairs (8000/0-C00.0) and either half may be the literal string NULL (8000/0-NULL). Also carries bare histology (8000/0), bare topography (C00.0), 3-digit groups (800) and ranges (801-804), plus one reversed pair (C57.9-8746/3). The leading/trailing \s* accommodates a known upstream defect: concept 36402927 has concept_code 9342/3 with a TRAILING SPACE, duplicating 44498515. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 64,471 concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 5,433 tabular / 1,045 paper tokens, 0 ordinary words - but two branches are worth knowing about before scanning text with this row: the literal NULL matches the English word NULL, and [A-Za-z]\d{2}(\.\d{1,2})? is shape-identical to an ICD-10 category, which is where 5,406 of the tabular hits come from. Both are real code forms, so neither is narrowable.

OI supplemental morphology-only split (histology/behavior). NOTE the id is ICD03 with a DIGIT ZERO, unlike stock ICDO3 with a LETTER O - they are different vocabularies. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 1,367 concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): ZERO hits in both corpora - the /behavior slash makes this row self-delimiting and it is the only ICD-O-3 row safe to run over free text unassisted.

Papers routinely cite bare 4-digit histology (8140) and drop the /behavior suffix - all 5 ICD-O-3 morphology codes in the litmine 2026-07 pilot arrived this way, so an exact join on the stored form would have matched none. Same class of trap as .DOTLESS. Validated 2026-07-27 against every stored code with its behavior suffix removed: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 17 tabular / 742 paper tokens, every one a bare 4-digit number - INCLUDING YEARS (1998, 2020, 2026). That is the price of the variant and it is deliberate, since papers print bare histology. Use it only where a 4-digit token is already known to be a code.

OI supplemental topography-only split. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 400 concept_codes: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 5,406 tabular / 94 paper tokens, 0 ordinary words. Every hit is an ICD-10-category-shaped token (C50.9), an unavoidable collision: ICD-O-3 topography is derived from the ICD-10 C-chapter shape.

Topography without the dot (C509 for C50.9). Validated 2026-07-27: 0 FN. Prose-scored 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir): 1,338 tabular / 101 paper tokens, 0 ordinary words - the same ICD-10 collision, dotless.

Korean Electronic Data Interchange procedure/reimbursement code (HIRA), the code system behind Korean NHIS claims. Added because the litmine 2026-07 pilot produced 13 Korean code sets that would otherwise have been dropped as unsupported. Validated 2026-07-27 vs 442,551 concept_codes: 0 FN. NARROWED 2026-08-13 (vocabulary_formats-wir) from \w{5,9}, which matched every 5-to-9-letter English word - aspirin included - and was the loosest row in the table by ordinary words admitted. Measured position by position over all 442,551 published codes: lengths are exactly 5, 8 or 9, and positions 4 AND 5 are digits in every single code (positions 1-3 and 6-9 mix letters and digits, so they stay \w). \w{3}\d{2}(\w{3,4})? therefore costs 0 FN. Measured 7,663 of 21,248 tabular tokens -> 1 (7,637 ordinary words -> 0) and 7,852 of 17,570 paper tokens -> 887 (6,763 -> 0); what remains are bare 5- and 9-digit numbers, which are real EDI shapes (ddddd, ddddddddd).
